name: react-vite-swr-workspace
description: Workspace root for the react-vite-swr example. It declares no dependencies of its own. It exists because Dependabot cannot find a pnpm-lock.yaml whose workspace root has no package.json (it bumped web/package.json and left the lockfile stale on #947 and #980), so .github/dependabot.yml points at this directory instead of at the members. Members and pnpm settings live in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
